## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the exercise, implementation or correction and the source requirements.

## Provenance and AI assistance

Identify AI contributions, existing baseline work and genuine human contributions.
Do not imply earlier phases or reviews happened if they did not.

## Actual verification

List executed commands, outcomes, plots/exports and unresolved limitations.
Distinguish local checks from GitHub Actions results.

## Review record and questions

Link the exercise review record and ask questions requiring student judgment.
Status: AWAITING_HUMAN_REVIEW (only after technical validation).

## Checklist

- [ ] Official requirements and acceptance criteria documented
- [ ] AI contributions disclosed; original history and metadata preserved
- [ ] Code and required outputs actually executed and checked
- [ ] CI result inspected, or pending/unavailable explicitly disclosed
- [ ] Scientific assumptions, limitations and remaining issues documented
- [ ] No secrets, private data or downloaded tools included
- [ ] Human feedback accurately recorded, if received
- [ ] Explicit human approval received and recorded (leave unchecked until true)
- [ ] Separate merge confirmation received (leave unchecked until true)

Never infer approval from green checks. Never submit assignments automatically.
